programme.desc: Eric and his team delve into the eerie history of the Jenkintown Library, a historic landmark with secrets lurking in the shadows. With Library Director Nina Meister, they uncover chilling activity no one ever suspected, revealing the library’s hidden, supernatural past. Prepare for a spine-tingling journey into the unknown as Eric Mintel and his team investigate the mysteries of this haunted location!

programme.title: Eric Mintel Investigates
programme.desc: Eric and Dominic descend on Bucks County's New Hope Winery. The team was called in to investigate some very strange paranormal activity! Sit back with your favorite vino and enjoy the latest video from Eric Mintel Investigates!

programme.title: Eric Mintel Investigates
programme.desc: Renowned jazz pianist and paranormal investigator Eric Mintel and Dominic Sattele, a psychic/intuitive, are showcasing their findings at the inn with the premiere of 'Old Lyme Inn Mysteries'!

programme.title: Eric Mintel Investigates
programme.desc: Eric Mintel and Dominic Sattele recieve reports of a low flying brightly lit object hovering silently over Bucks County, The two meet with witnesses who show them their cell phone videos and drawings of these objects. During a night investigation the team gets the shock of their lives and captures something they can't explain. Watch Eric Mintel Investigates, UFO's over Bucks County and decide for yourselves.

programme.title: Eric Mintel Investigates
programme.desc: Eric Mintel Investigates and The Vampa Museum team up for the thrilling new series Paranormal Activity Research Agency (PARA), also known as Paranormal Pickers. In this gripping 2025 series, lead investigator Eric Mintel and curator Edmondo Crimi delve into haunted objects and vampire lore, uncovering the dark origins of these mysterious items. Joined by spirit medium Dominic Sattele and psychic medium Julie Kraus, the team faces a chilling battle between good and evil as they search for the truth. Part 1 promises to kick off an intense paranormal journey unlike any other.

programme.title: Eric Mintel Investigates
programme.desc: Dominic Sattele locks in on a mysterious object, unraveling its dark energy, while Julie Kraus senses something lurking around an old barn on the property. The tension rises when Eric, Ed and Dominic enter the doll room, where eerie, unexplainable activity not only terrifies Dominic but turns the entire investigation upside down. As the team faces new threats, the paranormal intensity reaches unsettling heights, pushing their skills and courage to the limit.

programme.title: Eric Mintel Investigates
programme.desc: Lead Investigator Eric Mintel, Spirit Medium Dominic Sattele and guest Psychic medium Julie Kraus descend on the Waterwheel Tavern in beautiful Doylestown Bucks County PA. While on the investigation Julie discovers a possible residual haunting! What happens next on the investigation is something Eric and Dominic were not prepared for. Sit back and enjoy Eric Mintel Investigates "What waits at the Waterwheel Tavern?"
